title: The cooling plant: where the heat goes
alt: Section through a data hall with a chiller plant on the roof. In-row coolers in the rack row put the heat into water; the warm water rises up a pipe to two air-cooled chillers on the roof, which put the heat into the outside air; the cooled water goes back down to the hall.

steps.caption: In-row coolers in the hall put the servers' heat into water.
The warm water rises to chillers on the roof.
Most of the year outside air alone cools it; on warm days compressors help.
Without heat recovery, all of that heat goes into the air.
The cooled water goes back down to the hall, and the loop starts again.
